user: Is the deadline the same for every reason code?
answer:
No. Each reason code has its own window, counted in days from the transaction date:

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible. The window for the code you choose runs from the transaction date, so it's worth acting soon. Once you confirm the transaction and reason code, I'll run the eligibility check before anything is filed.
